snippet.title: Heroes of the Underworld
snippet.description:
A new standalone adventure in the same world as Heroes of the Seven Islands.

An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Underworld is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fantasy world, inspired by 90s games and comic books.
